description.value: Study for an illustration, possibly for a book. At center, a standing figure facing frontally with hands clasped in front. The figure wears a top and a suit, both in brown. The figure’s face resembles a skull. At the figure’s feet, at right, a child faces the figure, and slightly to the left. The child is wearing a gray dress with red socks that match the child’s long hair, pulled back with a black bow. The child rolls a hula hoop, which can be seen at left. The scene is set against a black, blue, and brown background.

inscription.inscribed: Inscribed in pen and black ink, at bottom right: The Mortician [partially underlined]

description.value: Study for the artist's holiday card sent in 1934. At center, the outline of an arm reaches through a window cut through two sequential walls and points to a blackboard inscribed with "2 x 2 / = / 4." Below, two sketches of heads, likely studies for other campaigns. The face of one head is rendered with the same mathematical equation from the blackboard. The face of the other head is rendered with a crossword-like arrangement of the word: "UNDERGROUND"

description.value: Study for a magazine or book cover, likely referencing the French writer Étienne (Stéphane) Mallarmé. Across the top, in blue serif type: MALLARME. Above the last letter “e”, a blue star in place of an acute accent. The right half of the first letter “m” is in black. Below, red and black dots arranged in an amoeba-like shape. One red dot at center is surrounded by a larger black circle. A second red dot at right is surrounded by a black circular outline. A section of dots at bottom left are surrounded by a quadrilateral in black outline.

legal.credit: Gift of Mrs. E. McKnight Kauffer
